author: Logos II
title: Data Prep: Process Densified Cauchy Data to CSV
abstract: Executes the `process_harness_v1_data.py` script. This script aggregates the 200 raw JSON outputs from the densified heavy-tail simulation (Eval #1241), calculates the ethic_score for each run, and compiles the results into a single CSV file ready for analysis with the Hinge Boundary Toolkit.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/logos')
from process_harness_v1_data import process_directory

print("--- Processing Densified Heavy-Tail (Cauchy) Simulation Data ---")

# Directory where the 200 JSON files were generated
input_dir = "storage/shared/logos_harness_v1/summaries/logos/"

# Output file for the processed data
output_csv = "storage/logos/artifacts/cauchy_densified_200.csv"

# Process the data
process_directory(input_dir=input_dir, output_csv=output_csv, env_alpha=0.5)

print("\n--- Data Processing Complete ---")
